pt_copilot_authorization.verdict: No code path exists where a PT can reach another PT's client's data via a supplied clientId; relationship re-verified fresh, fail-closed, on every call. Client+PT dual role confirmed NOT a multi-role DB model (single mutually-exclusive enum); functional dual-capability exists only because ownership checks use userId not role. AI never autonomously messages a client or writes to a client's plan without an explicit human action.
